ai.title: AI assistant
ai.hintOn: Explains findings in plain words, helps put the most important first, and answers questions in Ask Ziira. You can switch it off at any time.
ai.hint: Explains findings in plain words, helps put the most important first, and answers questions in Ask Ziira. Off until an Owner agrees below.
ai.notConfigured: The platform has no AI provider set up yet, so the assistant cannot be switched on. Ask your Ziira administrator.
ai.termsUnconfirmed: The platform has not yet confirmed its AI provider's data terms; no request will be sent until it does.
ai.consentOutdated: The consent text or the provider changed since this business agreed. Agree again to keep using the assistant.

does.explain: Writes a short plain-language explanation of a finding, from the finding's own figures.
does.rank: Suggests which findings to look at first, with a one-line reason.
does.ask: Answers questions in Ask Ziira, using defined queries over what the person asking is allowed to see.

ai.sentTitle: What is sent to the AI provider

sent.facts: The summary of a finding and the numbers the system calculated.
sent.answers: The results of the questions people ask (totals, counts, balances).
sent.people: Names of customers, suppliers and employees are replaced by labels such as “Customer A”.

ai.notSent: Phone numbers, email addresses, tax numbers, bank details, passwords, keys and salaries.
ai.guardsTitle: How the answers are kept honest

guards.figures: Every figure comes from your records. A reply with a number that is not in the data is thrown away, or marked as unverified.
guards.label: All AI text is labelled “AI-written”.
guards.scope: Ask Ziira answers only from what the person asking may see, in their own branches.
guards.log: Every request is logged: who, when, which queries and how many tokens. The text sent is not kept in the log.
guards.training: Your data is not used to train outside models; Ziira requires terms with the provider that rule this out.

ai.consentRead: I have read this and agree for this business.
ai.switchOffAsk: All AI features stop at once. Findings keep the explanations already written. You can switch it on again later by agreeing again.
ai.useExplanations: Write explanations of findings and help rank them
ai.useAuto: Explain new findings by itself in the background
ai.useAsk: Let people with the right use Ask Ziira
ai.budgetHint: Tokens are what AI providers count. When the limit is reached the assistant stops until next month or until you raise it.
ai.logHint: Every request to the AI provider, and every refusal to make one.
ai.logNoneHint: Requests appear here once the assistant is used.
ai.ownersOnly: Only an Owner can change the AI assistant.
ai.noCompany: There is no company to set up.
